tests.cmd: seed api:30…; scale 2 → api:60; cap 40 → api:40 cap_n=1

tests.name: pct_zero_total

tests.name: nonnum_preserve

weaknesses.title: PCTKV integer truncation; sum of percents may ≠ 100
weaknesses.detail: Total 72 → shares 55+27+13+2=97. Agents treating shares as a partition of 100 under-allocate. No remainder distribution / largest-remainder mode.

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric fields survive SCALEKV/PCTKV unchanged
weaknesses.detail: note:hello left as hello after SCALE*2 and PCT; excluded from PCTKV_SUM but still present in bag. Share digests can ship string junk. CAPKV also skips non-numeric (CAPKV_N unaffected).

weaknesses.title: PCTKV zero-total returns all-zero bag OK=1
weaknesses.detail: a:0 b:0 → a:0 b:0 with PCTKV_SUM=0 not soft miss. Program must special-case.

weaknesses.title: SCALEKV factor 0 silently zeros entire bag
weaknesses.detail: Destructive with OK=1. No refuse-on-zero-factor. Easy ENV typo FACTOR=0 wipes traffic SoT.

weaknesses.title: CAPKV only max clamp; no min floor form
weaknesses.detail: Iter 50 wanted CAPKV max — now have max only. No FLOORKV / clamp range. Outlier floor still EACH.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON bag newline collapse
weaknesses.detail: Stable; SCALE result looks single-field in JSON.

weaknesses.title: PCTKV_SUM is pre-percent total not sum of shares
weaknesses.detail: Naming confuses agents checking whether percents add to 100; must re-SUMKV the share bag.

workarounds: After PCTKV SUMKV share bag and tolerate remainder or redistribute largest remainder in agent
Refuse FACTOR<=0 at agent layer before SCALEKV
language_gaps: SCALE/CAP/PCT STRICT drop or refuse non-numeric
PCTKV_SHARE_SUM auto or rename PCTKV_SUM clarity
issues_faced: Positive scale→cap→pct pipeline works for LB share digests
Share field sum 97/100 is severe for routing weight math
Non-numeric preserve in PCT bag is high-sev contamination
No language fix — remainder mode for MEANINGFUL_ITER
